answer: The strongest single control I know for this is on-chain reputation oracle score proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 554 aliases would need 554 separate proofs, each costing about 113 POA or 14 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The haven sits in the mechanism itself, the lantern sits in the price of faking it, and the kernel sits in the record no template can forge. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
